svg.title: One output after two 3×3 layers can depend on a 5×5 input region
svg.desc: Output position (3,3) reads intermediate rows and columns 2–4. Those nine positions together cover input rows and columns 1–5. This is a structural receptive field, not a larger kernel or identical output values.
svg.text: One output after two 3×3 layers can depend on a 5×5 input region
stride=1 · padding=1 · dilation=1 · no Pool · trace interior output (3,3)
The nine intermediate positions cover a 5×5 input region, in every input channel.
Direct weighted sum over a 5×5 region
Comparison: 16 input/output channels in every layer · bias=False
The spatial extent can match while the computations and outputs differ.
The two-layer stack has 1,792 fewer weights (28%). This alone does not establish speed or accuracy.
